_comment: Example recipe (built-in, read-only) of the short-tube profile of stations/example_tube_line.json: is a tube on the seat at all (`presence`: anything 10 mm above the seat plane - what the line's part-present sensor claims), and its position on its seat against a GOOD part (golden). A tube off its seat turns the seat RED with a cross where it is furthest off. Make the golden with `scan recipe-golden tube_short_alignment` on a good part. Mock: scene:tube_short (good), scene:tube_short:misaligned.
name: tube_short_alignment
description: Short tube (38 mm): position on its seat vs the good part
